harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الكتاب»: badal (substitute) in the nominative with ḍamma. «هدى»: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. The clause «لا ريب فيه» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلك»; the preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «لا». «هدى» is a ḥāl from «الكتاب». The preposition «للمتقين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «هدى».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «للمتقين». The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The nominal clause «هم يوقنون» is conjoined to the verbal clause «يؤمنون», with no grammatical position. The preposition «بالآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوقنون». الآخرة is the feminine of آخِر, the opposite of أوَّل (first); it was originally an adjective that came to be treated as a noun, and the implied form is الدار الآخرة (the last abode). The past tense of «يوقنون» is أيقن; its original form is يُؤَيْقِنون: the hamza of the af‘ala pattern was dropped by analogy with its dropping from the imperfect attributed to the first-person singular, so it became يُيْقِنون; then the yāʾ occurred vowelless after a ḍamma and was changed into wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «هم»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. «المفلحون»: khabar (predicate) in the nominative with wāw of the demonstrative «أولئك». The clause «أولئك على هدى» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «سواء»: khabar (predicate) placed first, nominative; the preposition «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (سواء). «أأنذرتهم»: the hamza is that of equalisation (taswiya), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from it and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the implied form is "your warning and its absence are equal". The clause is parenthetical, and the clause «لا يؤمنون» is the khabar of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «ختم الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «وعلى أبصارهم غشاوة» is conjoined to the clause «ختم», with no grammatical position. The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «على أبصارهم غشاوة», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The wāw is resumptive. His words «وما هم بمؤمنين»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ما» is negative, working like laysa. The bāʾ in «بمؤمنين» is redundant (zāʾida), and the noun with it is genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «يخادعون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «وما يخدعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يخادعون», and the clause «وما يشعرون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يخدعون», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «فزادهم الله» is conjoined to the clause «في قلوبهم مرض», with no grammatical position. «مرضا»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «فزادهم الله», with no grammatical position. The clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative «ما», with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied notion of "being established" in «لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring back to its maṣdar (verbal noun); the implied form is "and when a saying is said to them". We have chosen to make the deputy the pronoun of the maṣdar because it is more informative than the preposition and its genitive noun. The clause «وإذا قيل لهم» is conjoined to the clause {يَقُولُ} in verse (8).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «ألا»: a particle of alerting (tanbīh). «هم»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of «إن»; the detached nominative pronoun is used to emphasise all kinds of attached pronoun. The clause «ولكن لا يشعرون» is conjoined to the clause «إنهم هم المفسدون».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: His words «آمنوا كما آمن الناس»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar; «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "believe with a belief like the belief of the people", and the interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). Likewise «كما آمن السفهاء». The clause «ولكن لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «إنهم هم السفهاء».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وإذا لقوا» is conjoined to the clause {وَإِذَا قِيلَ} before it, with no grammatical position. «لقوا»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters after it was made vowelless; the original form is لقِيُوا. The wāw is the fāʿil (agent). «خلَوا»: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, since it is joined to the wāw of the plural. The wāw is the fāʿil. «معكم»: an adverb of place indicating accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ», i.e. "we are with you". The clause «إنما نحن مستهزئون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «الله يستهزئ بهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «يعمهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «يمدهم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فما ربحت تجارتهم» is conjoined to the clause «اشتروا», so like it, it has no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «مثلهم كمثل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in {كَانُوا} in the previous verse. «فلما»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما» is a particle of "necessity because of necessity" (wujūb li-wujūb); it is a non-jussive conditional particle. The clause «فلما أضاءت» is conjoined to the clause «استوقد», with no grammatical position. The clause «لا يبصرون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «تركهم».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «صم»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they are deaf" (هم صم); the clause «هم صم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw of «لا يبصرون». The clause «فهم لا يرجعون» is conjoined to the clause «هم صم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «كصيب»: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "their likeness is as a rainstorm" (مثلهم كصيب). The clause «مثلهم كصيب» is conjoined to the clause «مثلهم كمثل» in verse (17). The clause «فيه ظلمات» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «صيِّب», in the position of the genitive. The clause «يجعلون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and so is the clause «والله محيط».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «كلما»: «كلَّ» is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشَوا», and «ما» is a temporal maṣdariyya. The interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is "they walked in it at every time of its giving light". The clause «أضاء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, with no grammatical position, and the clause «مَشَوا» is resumptive. The clause «وإذا أظلم» is conjoined to the clause «مشوا», with no grammatical position. The clause «ولو شاء الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «يا أيها»: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيها» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for alerting; «الناس» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). «والذين»: a relative noun conjoined to the accusative pronoun in «خلقكم». The preposition «مِن قبلكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «اعبدوا ربكم» is the response to the vocative, resumptive, and so is the clause «لعلكم تتقون».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «الذي»: a relative noun, badal (substitute) from {رَبَّكُمُ}, in the position of the accusative. «والسماء بناء»: the wāw is a conjunction; «السماء» is a noun conjoined to «الأرض», and «بناء» is a noun conjoined to «فراشا», accusative with fatḥa; so the wāw has conjoined two nouns to two nouns. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رزقا». «لا»: a prohibitive, jussive-governing particle. The preposition «لله» is attached to the implied second object, i.e. "so do not make rivals (to be) belonging to Allah". The clause «فلا تجعلوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, in the position of the jussive, i.e. "if He has given you this, then do not make…". The clause «وأنتم تعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تجعلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «وإن كنتم» is resumptive. The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «ريب». The preposition «من مثله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «سورة». The preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شهداءكم». The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فإن لم تفعلوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause {وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ}. The clause «وقودها الناس» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative. The clause «أُعِدَّت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «النار», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «أنَّ» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. «كلما»: «كل» is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا», and «ما» is a temporal maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the implied form is "they said at every time of being provided". The preposition «من ثمرة» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «منها», attached to «رُزقوا»; two prepositions with the same meaning are not attached to a single governor except by way of substitution or conjunction. «وأُتُوا»: the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «قالوا» is resumptive, and the clause «رزقوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. «متشابها» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «به». The clause «ولهم فيها أزواج» is conjoined to the clause «وأُتوا», in the position of the accusative. The preposition «فيها» is attached to the implied notion of "being established" in the omitted khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يضرب» is accusative by removal of the preposition «مِنْ»; «مثلا» is the object of «يضرب», «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and «بعوضة» is a badal (substitute) from «مثلا». The fāʾ in «فما فوقها» is a conjunction; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «بعوضة». His words «ماذا أراد»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, khabar (predicate); «مثلا» is tamyīz (specification), «كثيرا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يُضل به كثيرا» is resumptive, and the clause «وما يُضِل به» is conjoined to the first clause «يُضل به», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the interpreted maṣdar «أن يوصل» is a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in «به», i.e. "what Allah commanded to be joined". «هم الخاسرون»: «هم» is a pronoun of separation with no grammatical position, and «الخاسرون» is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; the clause «أولئك الخاسرون» is the khabar of «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «تكفرون» is resumptive. «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تكفرون»; the clause «وكنتم» is circumstantial, and the clause «تُرْجَعون» is conjoined to the clause «يُحْييكم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), i.e. "(what) is settled in the earth". «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». «سبع»: second object. The clause «وهو بكل شيء عليم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «هو الذي», with no grammatical position. The preposition «بكل» is attached to «عليم». The intensive forms (ṣiyagh al-mubālagha) have differed from their verbs in transitivity and resembled the elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl), so they became transitive with the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The wāw is resumptive. «إذ»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; the clause «قال» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «خليفة»: mafʿūl bihi of the active participle «جاعل», nominative with ḍamma [Translator's note: so in the source; «خليفة» is accusative (with fatḥa) as an object]. The clause «ونحن نسبح بحمدك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the preposition «بحمدك» is attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «نسبح». The clause «قال إني أعلم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «وعلَّم» is resumptive, and the clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «سبحانك»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), governed in the accusative by an implied verb that must remain unexpressed; it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being التسبيح. The clause «لا علم لنا» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech. «ما»: a relative noun meaning "that which", indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) from the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause «إنك أنت العليم» is resumptive, and «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun kāf in «إنك».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «فلما»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لمَّا» is a particle of "necessity because of necessity" (wujūb li-wujūb). The clause «فلما أنبأهم» is conjoined to the clause «قال», with no grammatical position, and the clause «قال» is the apodosis of the non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. The clause «وأعلم» is conjoined to the previous clause «أعلم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to «إذ» in verse (30), and the clause «قلنا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) in the position of the genitive. The clause «أبى» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «أنت»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in «اسكن». «وزوجك»: the wāw is a conjunction; «زوجك» is a noun conjoined to the latent pronoun in «اسكن», and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «رغدا»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; the implied form is "an eating in abundance". «حيث»: an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلا», and the clause «شئتما» is muḍāf ilayhi in the position of the genitive. «فتكونا»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and the verb is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect, accusative by «أن» necessarily implied after the fāʾ; the sign of its accusative is the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs. The alif is the noun of «تكون». The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أنْ» and what follows it is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding verb, i.e. "let there be no approaching from you two, and (thus) being…"; the clause «تكونا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «وقلنا» is resumptive. The clause «بعضكم لبعض عدو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «اهبطوا», in the position of the accusative. The clause «ولكم في الأرض مستقر» is conjoined to the clause «بعضكم لبعض عدو», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «إنه هو التواب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنه». «الرحيم»: second khabar (predicate), nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «إمَّا» is composed of «إن», a jussive conditional particle, and «ما», which is redundant (zāʾida). «فَمَنْ»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تبع» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). The clause «فمن تبع هداي فلا خوف عليهم» is the apodosis of the first condition, in the position of the jussive. The clause «فلا خوف عليهم» is the apodosis of the second condition, in the position of the jussive. The clause «ولا هم يحزنون» is conjoined to the apodosis clause.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «والذين»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its clause is conjoined to the clause {فَمَنْ تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلا خَوْفٌ}. The nominal clause «أولئك أصحاب النار» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «الذين», and the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «التي»: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of «نعمتي», in the position of the accusative. «أوف»: an imperfect in the jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you fulfil, I will fulfil". «وإيَّاي»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إيَّا» is a detached accusative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, of an implied verb explained by what follows, its implied form being "fear" (ارهبوا), and the yāʾ is for the first person; the implied form is "and Me fear, so fear Me". «فارهبون»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the verb is an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya). The implied clause «ارهبوا» is conjoined to the clause «أوْفوا», with no grammatical position, and the clause «ارهبون» is explicative of the implied verb, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «مصدقا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied returning pronoun (أنزلته). «لما»: the lām is a redundant preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «معكم»: «مع» is an adverb of accompaniment, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and «كم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) «أول», when annexed to an indefinite, agrees with what precedes it; but «كافر» was not put in the plural here because the elative is annexed to an omitted singular conveying plurality, whose adjective remains, i.e. "the first disbelieving group". «وإياي فاتقون» is like {وَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ} above. The implied clause «اتقوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تشتروا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وأنتم تعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «وأنتم تتلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). «أفلا»: the hamza is interrogative and the fāʾ is a conjunction; it has conjoined the clause «تعقلون» to the clause «تأمرون».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «وإنها لكبيرة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), preceded by speech with a negative meaning, i.e. "it is not easy except for…". The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كبيرة».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أنّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «ظنَّ». The second maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar; the implied form is "they think of meeting their Lord and returning to Him".

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «وأني فضَّلتكم»: the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أنّ» and what follows it is conjoined to «نعمتي», i.e. "remember My favour and My preferring (you)".

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «يوما»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «لا تجزي نفس» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; the original is "will not avail in it", then (the "in it") was omitted. «شيئا»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "will not avail any availing, little or much". The clause «ولا هم ينصرون» is conjoined to the clause «ولا يؤخذ منها عدل», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied "remember" (اذكروا), and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause {وَاتَّقُوا}, with no grammatical position. «سوء»: second object, accusative. The clause «يسومونكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آل فرعون», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «يذبِّحون» is explicative, with no grammatical position. The clause «وفي ذلكم بلاء» is resumptive. The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بلاء», and «عظيم» is a naʿt of «بلاء».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to the earlier «إذ». «أربعين»: second object, i.e. "the completion of forty", accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, and «ليلة» is tamyīz (specification), accusative. The clause «وأنتم ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «ذلك» is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «يا قوم»: the one addressed (munādā), annexed, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness. The clause «إنكم ظلمتم» is resumptive, the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position. «فتوبوا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «ظلمتم». «فتاب»: the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e. "so you did what you were commanded, and He turned (to you)". The clause «ذلكم خير» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إنه هو التواب»; «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun hāʾ in «إنه».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «جهرة»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, i.e. "a manifest seeing". The clause «فأخذَتْكم» is conjoined to the clause «قلتم». The clause «وأنتم تنظرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «كلوا» is the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, i.e. "and We said to them: eat"; the implied clause is conjoined to the clause «أنزلنا». «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وما ظلمونا» is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "so they were ungrateful for these blessings, and they did not…", and the clause «ولكن كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما ظلمونا». «أنفسهم» is the object of «يظلمون», and the clause «يظلمون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna. «كُلوا» is the imperative of أكل, on the pattern عُلوا; the original is اؤكلوا: the hamza was dropped irregularly, and once it was dropped the connecting hamza was no longer needed since the vowelless hamza had gone; then it was attributed to the wāw of the plural.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «إذ» is conjoined to «إذ» in verse (55). «هذه»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «القرية»: badal (substitute), accusative. The clause «شئتم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of the genitive. «رغَدا»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, i.e. "an eating in abundance". «سُجَّدا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ادخلوا», accusative. «حِطَّة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "our request is ḥiṭṭa (relief from sins)"; it is a maṣdar of manner, and the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «نغفر»: jussive because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you say (it), We will forgive". The clause «وسنزيد المحسنين» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «فبدَّل الذين» is conjoined to the preceding clause {قُلْنَا}, in the position of the genitive. «قولا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «غير» is a naʿt (adjective), accusative. The clause «فأنزلنا» is conjoined to the clause «بدَّل». The preposition «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «رجزا»; «ما» in «بما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to «أنزلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «فانفجرت»: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "so he struck, and there gushed forth". «اثنتا»: fāʿil (agent), nominative with alif because it is treated like the dual, and «عشرة» is a part (of the compound number), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position. The clause «قد علم كل أناس» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «اثنتا عشرة», and the link is implied, i.e. "of them". The clause «كلوا» is the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying.

harrat-mujtaba:261-261.t: The clause «أنبتت» is in the position of the genitive as a ṣifa (adjective) of «جنة» [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun in the verse that «أنبتت» qualifies is «حبة»], the clause «في كل سنبلة مائة حبة» is in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa of «سبع», and the clause «والله يضاعف» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; likewise the clause «والله واسع».

harrat-mujtaba:262-262.t: «منًّا»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «يتبعون», and the clause «لهم أجرهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», and the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أجرهم». And His saying «ولا خوف عليهم»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» operates like laysa, «خوف» is its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun «عليهم» is attached to the khabar of «لا». And the clause «ولا هم يحزنون» is conjoined to the clause «ولا خوف عليهم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:263-263.t: Beginning with the indefinite «قول» is permitted because it is qualified, and the khabar (predicate) is «خير», and the preposition phrase «من صدقة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». And the clause «يتبعها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صدقة», in the position of the genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:264-264.t: The clause «لا تبطلوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The preposition phrase «كالذي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw, i.e.: do not invalidate your charity resembling the one who…; and His saying «رئاء»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb). And the clause «فمثله كمثل» is conjoined to the clause «لا يؤمن», with no grammatical position; the clause «عليه تراب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صفوان», in the position of the genitive; and His saying «صلدا»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «ترك» having the sense of «صيَّر» (made). And the clause «لا يقدرون» is a ḥāl of «الذي», in the position of the accusative, and the pronoun is made plural according to the meaning.

harrat-mujtaba:265-265.t: The verb «آتت» is transitive to two objects; the first is implied (muqaddar), i.e. its owners, and «أكلها» is the second object. And His saying «ضعفين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أكلها», accusative with the yāʾ. And His saying «فطل»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «طل» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is implied, i.e. «يصيبها» (falls upon it); and the clause «فطل يصيبها» is the apodosis of a jussive-governing conditional, in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:266-266.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تكون» is the object of «ودَّ». In His saying «له فيها من كل الثمرات» there is an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «وله فيها رزق من كل الثمرات» (and he has in it provision of all fruits); the preposition phrase «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached, and the preposition phrase «من كل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رزق». And the clause «له فيها رزق» is a second naʿt of «جنة», in the position of the nominative. The wāw in «وأصابه» is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); likewise the wāw in «وله ذرية». And the clause «فيه نار» is a naʿt (ṣifa) of «إعصار». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: He makes clear a making clear like that making clear; and the clause «لعلكم تتفكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:267-267.t: The clause «تنفقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تيمموا». His saying «ولستم بآخذيه»: the wāw is circumstantial, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of laysa; the interpreted maṣdar «أن تغمضوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ; and the clause «ولستم بآخذيه» is a ḥāl of the wāw of «تنفقون», and the clause «واعلموا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:268-268.t: «الفقر» is the second object of «وعد»; the preposition phrase «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مغفرة».

harrat-mujtaba:269-269.t: «مَنْ» is a relative noun, first object; the clause «ومن يؤت» is resumptive. «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «خيرا» is the second object; the clause «وما يذَّكر» is resumptive. «أولو» is fāʿil (agent), nominative with the wāw because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:270-270.t: «ما» is a conditional noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition phrase «من نفقة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما», and «مِنْ» is explicative (bayāniyya). The preposition phrase «من نذر» is attached to a ṣifa (adjective) of «ما». And «من أنصار»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); and the clause «وما للظالمين من أنصار» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:271-271.t: «فنِعِمَّا هي»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «نِعْم» is a past verb of praise; its middle radical was originally vowelless, so when «ما» came after it and the mīm of «نعم» was assimilated into it, the middle radical was given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; and «ما» is a complete definite noun, fāʿil (agent), i.e.: «نِعْم الشيء هي» (an excellent thing it is); and «هي» is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «فهي نعم الشيء» is the apodosis, in the position of the jussive, and the clause «نعم الشيء» is a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «هي». A khabar of a mubtadaʾ being a fronted verbal clause is contrary to the basic rule. The clause «ويكفر» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «والله خبير».

harrat-mujtaba:272-272.t: The clause «ولكن الله يهدي» is conjoined to the clause «ليس عليك هداهم», with no grammatical position. «ما» in His saying «وما تنفقوا» is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition phrase «من خير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما»; and the preposition phrase «فلأنفسكم» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «فهو لأنفسكم» (then it is for yourselves). The wāw in His saying «وما تنفقون» is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical; «ابتغاء» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the clause «وأنتم لا تظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; and the second clause «وما تنفقوا» is conjoined to the first clause «وما تنفقوا».

harrat-mujtaba:273-273.t: The preposition phrase «للفقراء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «الصدقات للفقراء» (the charities are for the poor). The clause «لا يستطيعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «أُحصِروا», and «ضربا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يحسبهم» is a second ḥāl of the wāw, and likewise the two clauses «تعرفهم» and «لا يسألون». The preposition phrase «من التعفف» is attached to «يحسبهم», and «إلحافا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl. And the clause «وما تنفقوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:274-274.t: «سرا» is an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «فلهم أجرهم» is khabar (predicate), and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). The adverb «عند ربهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «أجرهم»; the clause «ولا خوف عليهم» is conjoined to the clause «فلهم أجرهم». And the clause «ولا هم يحزنون» is conjoined to the clause «ولا خوف عليهم».

harrat-mujtaba:275-275.t: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e.: a standing like the standing of…. The maṣdar «بأنهم قالوا» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). And the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar of «أولئك», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:276-276.t: The clause «والله لا يحب كل كفار» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:277-277.t: The clause «لهم أجرهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ», in the position of the nominative, and «عند ربهم» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أجرهم». And His saying «ولا خوف عليهم»: «لا» is negating, operating like laysa, «خوفٌ» is its noun, and the preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to the implied (muqaddar) khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:278-278.t: The preposition phrase «من الربا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «بقي». The conditional clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e.: if you are believers, then give up what remains.

harrat-mujtaba:279-279.t: The preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حرب», the clause «وإن تبتم» is conjoined to the clause «إن لم تفعلوا», and the clause «لا تظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «لكم».

harrat-mujtaba:280-280.t: «كان» is a complete (tāmm) past verb, and «ذو» is fāʿil (agent), nominative with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. And His saying «فنظرة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «فالواجب» (then what is obligatory is…), and the preposition phrase «إلى ميسرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of «نظرة». The maṣdar «أن تصدَّقوا» is mubtadaʾ, and the clause «إن كنتم تعلمون» is resumptive, its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) being omitted, indicated by what precedes.

harrat-mujtaba:281-281.t: «يوما» here is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and not an adverb, because the command is to guard against the day, not to guard during it. The clause «تُرجعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوما». And the clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كل نفس».

harrat-mujtaba:282-282.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, occurring as the response to the vocative. «إذا» is adverbial-conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the implied form being: writing is required when you contract a debt; it is not attached to «اكتبوه», because what follows the fāʾ does not govern what precedes it. The lām in «ليكتب» is the jussive lām of command; it is originally with kasra, and making it vowelless is a lightening. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يكتب» is the object of «يأب». His saying «كما علّمه»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a writing like…, and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi. His saying «فليكتب»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if the scribe is asked to write, let him write. The clause «أو لا يستطيع» is conjoined to the khabar (predicate) of «كان», in the position of the accusative. «هو» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the fāʿil (agent) of «يمل». The preposition phrase «من رجالكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شهيدين». «فرجل»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; «رجل»: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «فالشاهد» (then the witness is…). The preposition phrase «ممن ترضون» is attached to a naʿt of «رجل» and «امرأتان». The interpreted maṣdar «أن تضل» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear that she errs. «صغيرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ. His saying «إذا ما دعوا»: purely adverbial, attached to «يأب», and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). «عند» is an adverb of place attached to «أقسط». The preposition phrase «للشهادة» is attached to «أقوم». The interpreted maṣdar «أن تكتبوه» is accusative by removal of the preposition «من». The preposition phrase «إلى أجله» is attached to an omitted ḥāl of the hāʾ in «تكتبوه». «عند» is an adverb of place attached to «أقسط»; the preposition phrase «للشهادة» is attached to «أقوم». The interpreted maṣdar «ألا ترتابوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition «إلى». The maṣdar «إلا أن تكون» is accusative, a disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) excepted. The clause «تديرونها» is a second naʿt of «تجارة». His saying «ولا يضارّ»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn, and given a fatḥa because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. And the clause «ويُعلمكم الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:283-283.t: «فرهان»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «فالبديل» (then the substitute is…). The clause «فإن أمن بعضكم» is conjoined to the clause «وإن كنتم»; «أمانته» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يؤد»; «ربه» is a badal (substitute) of the Divine Name; «آثم» is the khabar of «إن»; «قلبه» is fāʿil (agent) of «آثم», nominative; the clause «والله بما تعملون عليم» is resumptive. The preposition phrase «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:284-284.t: The clause «وإن تبدوا ما في أنفسكم» is resumptive, and the clause «فيغفر» is resumptive. The preposition phrase «على كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قدير).

harrat-mujtaba:285-285.t: The clause «كلٌ آمن بالله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «لا نفرق» is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, its implied form being «يقولون» (they say), and the clause of the implied saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: saying, «لا نفرق». The preposition phrase «من رسله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أحد». «غفرانك»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb, its implied form being «اغفر» (forgive). The clause «ربّنا» is parenthetical between the parts of the speech, with no grammatical position, and the clause «وإليك المصير» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: «منك المبدأ، وإليك المصير» (from You is the beginning, and to You is the return), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:286-286.t: «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «وسعها» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; the clause «لها ما كسبت» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the clause «ربّنا» is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e.: say, «ربّنا». The second and third clauses «ربنا» are parenthetical. «كما حملته»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e.: a burdening like Your burdening of…. The clause «أنت مولانا» is resumptive, and the clause «فانصرنا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «فادع»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «نصبر». «من بقلها»: badal (substitute) from «مما». The preposition «بالذي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تستبدلون»; the bāʾ has entered on the thing given up. The clause «فإنَّ لكم ما» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, within the scope of the speech, and so is the clause «وضُربت عليهم الذلة». The preposition «بغضب» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «باءوا», i.e. "bound up with wrath". The interpreted maṣdar «بأنهم كانوا» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يقتلون». The clause «ذلك بما عَصَوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «عَصَوا»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; the wāw is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. «ما» in «بما» is maṣdariyya.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «مَن»: a jussive conditional noun, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «فلهم أجرهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ. «عند ربهم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of "being established" to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. «ولا خوف عليهم»: «لا» is negative, working like laysa, and «خوف» is its noun, nominative. The clause «مَنْ آمن فلهم أجرهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «إن الذين». The clause «ولا خوف عليهم» is conjoined to the apodosis, in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to the earlier «إذ». The clause «خذوا» is the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the implied saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «رفعنا»; the implied form is "and We raised the Mount, saying to you: take". The preposition «بقوة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «خذوا», i.e. "bound up (with strength)". The clause «لعلكم تتقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «فلولا»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). «فضل»: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing". The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (فضل).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: «ولقد»: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām introduces the response to an implied oath; the preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «اعتدوا». «خاسئين» is a second khabar (predicate). Taking it as a khabar is preferable to taking it as an adjective, because the sound plural is not an adjective of what is non-rational.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «فجعلناها» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «نكالا»: second object. The preposition «لما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نكالا».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن تذبحوا» is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. «هُزُوا»: second object, accusative. The two clauses «قالوا» and «قال» are resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن أكون» is accusative by removal of the preposition (من).

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «يبين» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. «ما هي»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun is its khabar (predicate); its clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «يُبَيِّن». This clause has suspended «يبيِّن» from governing (taʿlīq), because it resembles the verbs of the heart. «لا فارض»: «لا» is negative with no governing effect, and «فارض» is an adjective of «بقرة», nominative; the repetition of «لا» is obligatory. «ولا بكر»: conjoined to «فارض»; «عوان» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بقرة», and «بين» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «عوان». The clause «فافعلوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: His words «ما لونها»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «لونها» is the khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «صفراء»: naʿt (adjective), nominative; «فاقع» is a second adjective, and «لونها» is the fāʿil (agent) of «فاقع»; the clause «تسرُّ» is an adjective of «بقرة».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «إن البقر تشابه» is resumptive. The clause «إنَّا لمهتدون» is conjoined to the clause «إن البقر تشابه», with no grammatical position. The clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the context.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «لا ذلول»: «لا» is negative with no governing effect, and «ذلول» is an adjective of «بقرة». The clause «تثير» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun in «ذلول», i.e. "it is not made submissive while ploughing the earth". «مسلمة»: an adjective of «بقرة», and the clause «لا شية فيها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بقرة», in the position of the nominative. The clause «قالوا» is resumptive, and the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جئت». The clause «فذبحوها» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «وما كادوا» is circumstantial, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The clause «والله مخرج» is parenthetical between the two clauses «ادَّارأتم» and «قلنا». «ما» is a relative noun meaning "that which", object of «مخرج».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar; the implied form is "Allah gives life to the dead with a giving of life like that giving of life". «ذا» is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «يُحيي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «فهي كالحجارة» is conjoined to the clause «قست قلوبكم», with no grammatical position. «أو أشد»: «أو» is a conjunction, and «أشد» is a nominative noun conjoined to the notion of "being established" to which the khabar (predicate) is attached, i.e. "so they are as stones or harder". «قسوة»: tamyīz (specification), accusative; the accusative noun after the elative is a tamyīz. «وإنَّ»: the wāw is resumptive; «إنَّ» is an abrogating particle; the preposition «من الحجارة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar of «إن». «لما»: the lām is for emphasis, and «ما» is a nominal relative in the position of the accusative as the noun of «إن». The clause «ثم قست» is conjoined to something implied, i.e. "so he came to life", with no grammatical position. The clause «وما الله بغافل» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «أفتطمعون»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the hamza is intended to come after the fāʾ; the hamza has been put first because it has the right to the head of the clause. The interpreted maṣdar «أن يؤمنوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition «في». The clause «وقد كان فريق» is circumstantial, in the position of the accusative. «ما» in «ما عقلوه» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «وهم يعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «أفلا تعقلون»: the hamza is interrogative and the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause «تعقلون» is conjoined to the clause «تحدِّثونهم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: His words «أولا يعلمون»: the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is resumptive, «لا» is negative, and «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «لا يَعْلَمُونَ» is an adjective of «أمِّيُّون», in the position of the nominative. «أمانيَّ» is a disjoined excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), accusative. The clause «إن هم إلا يظنون» is conjoined to the clause «منهم أميُّون», with no grammatical position; «إن» is negative, «إلا» is for restriction, and the clause «يظنون» is the khabar (predicate) of «هم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: His words «فويل»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive. «ويل»: mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it is an imprecation. The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of "being established" to which the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «ويل» is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «أياما»: an adverb (ẓarf), accusative with fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تمسَّنا». «أتخذتم»: the hamza of disapproval (inkār) has made the connecting hamza unnecessary. The clause «أم تقولون» is conjoined to the clause «أتخذتم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «بلى»: a particle of answer. «مَنْ»: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «من كسب» is resumptive. The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «والذين آمنوا» is conjoined to the clause {مَنْ كَسَبَ}, with no grammatical position. The clause «أولئك أصحاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». The clause «هم خالدون» is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is the object of an implied "remember"; it was not conjoined to the earlier «إذ» because of the long separation. The clause «لا تعبدون» is the response to an oath, because the taking of the covenant is an oath. «وبالوالدين إحسانا»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "do good to the parents", and «إحسانا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause «أحسنوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تعبدون». «حسنا»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "a good saying", accusative. The clause «توليتم» is conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "so you accepted, then you turned away". The clause «وأنتم معرضون» is circumstantial, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun conjoined to the earlier «إذ». The clause «لا تسفكون» is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position, because the taking of the covenant has the meaning of an oath. The clause «أقررتم» is conjoined to the clause «تخرجون», with no grammatical position. The clause «وأنتم تشهدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «ثم أنتم هؤلاء تقتلون» is conjoined to the clause {ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ}, with no grammatical position. «أنتم»: a detached nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «هؤلاء»: the hāʾ is for alerting, and «أولاء» is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "I censure"; the clause «أذمُّ هؤلاء» is parenthetical. The clause «تقتلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم»; the clause «تظاهرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تُخرجون», and the clause «وإن يأتوكم» is conjoined to the clause «تقتلون», in the position of the nominative. The clause «وهو محرم عليكم إخراجهم» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «تخرجون»; the wāw is circumstantial, «هو» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), mubtadaʾ, and «محرم» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «إخراجهم». The clause «أفتؤمنون» is resumptive, and so is the clause «فما جزاء». «جزاء»: mubtadaʾ, nominative; «من» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «خزي» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; «إلا» is for restriction, preceded by the negative «ما»; and the preposition «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «خزي». The clause {يُرَدُّونَ} is conjoined to the nominal clause «فما جزاء ... إلا خزي», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «أولئك الذين»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «فلا يخفف» is conjoined to the clause «اشتروا». The clause «ولا هم ينصرون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يخفف», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «لقد آتينا» is the response to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. «أفكلما»: the hamza is interrogative and the fāʾ is resumptive; «كل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استكبرتم», and «ما» is an adverbial maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and what follows it is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the implied form is "so you were arrogant at every time of a messenger's coming". The clause «استكبرتم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «ففريقا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «فريقا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, accusative. The clause «تقتلون» is conjoined to the clause «كَذَّبتم».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «بل لعنهم الله» is resumptive, and «بل» is for digression (iḍrāb). «فقليلا ما يؤمنون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «قليلا»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, i.e. "they believe with little belief"; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «يؤمنون» is conjoined to the clause «لعنهم الله», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The wāw is resumptive; «لما» is a particle of "necessity because of necessity" (wujūb li-wujūb). The preposition «من عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «كتاب», and «مصدق» is a second adjective of «كتاب». «لِما»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), strengthening the transitivity of the active participle to what it governs, and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «معهم»: an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). His words «وكانوا»: the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical. «فلما»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لمَّا» is a particle of "necessity because of necessity". «فلعنة»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive. The first clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of the relative, and the second clause «فلما جاءهم» is conjoined to the first; it was repeated because of the long separation. The clause «كفروا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition, which is the first «لما», and the apodosis of the second was omitted because the apodosis of the first indicates it.

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: «بئس»: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for blame. «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent), and its clause is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar «أن يكفروا» is the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm); it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "evil is that for which they sold themselves: it is their disbelief", and the clause «هو أن يكفروا» is explicative. «بغيا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The interpreted maṣdar «أن ينزل» is accusative by removal of the preposition «على». The preposition «من فضله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of an omitted qualified noun which is the object of «ينزل», i.e. "Allah sends down something that is of His bounty". The preposition «من عباده» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the returning pronoun, i.e. "upon whom He wills, being of His servants"; the preposition «بغضب» is attached to a ḥāl from the wāw, i.e. "bound up (with wrath)"; and the preposition «على غضب» is attached to an adjective of «غضب». The clause «فباءوا» is conjoined to the clause «بئسما», with no grammatical position, and the clause «وللكافرين عذاب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «إذا», among the conditional particles, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis (jawāb), and its apodosis in the verse is «قالوا». The clause «ويكفرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the circumstantial wāw may be joined to an affirmative imperfect. The adverb «وراءه» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause) "is (settled)", and the clause «وهو الحق» is circumstantial. «مصدقا»: an emphatic ḥāl from «الحق»; «ما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the lām is redundant (zāʾida). «فلِم»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis of an implied condition; the implied form is "if you have believed, then why do you kill?". The alif of the interrogative «ما» was dropped because it is genitive. The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The preposition «بالبينات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاءكم». The clause «ثم اتخذتم» is conjoined to the clause «لقد جاءكم», with no grammatical position. The clause «وأنتم ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative, from the tāʾ in «اتخذتم».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to «إذ» in verse (84). The clause «خذوا» is the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "and We said", in the position of the accusative. The preposition «بقوة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "bound up with strength". The clause «قالوا» is resumptive, and the clause «وأشربوا» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; the circumstantial wāw may be joined to an affirmative past verb. «بئسما»: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for blame, and «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being "the worship of the calf".

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «عند»: an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of "being established" to which the khabar (predicate) of «كانت» is attached. «خالصة»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الدار», accusative. The preposition «من دون» is attached to «خالصة». His words «فتمنوا»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the verb is an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is joined to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «والله عليم بالظالمين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The clause «ولتجدنهم» occurs as the response to an implied oath, and the implied clause «أقسم» (I swear) is conjoined to the clause {وَلَنْ يَتَمَنَّوْهُ}. «أحرص»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) has been annexed to a definite noun and so came in the singular, according to one of the two permissible options, and did not agree with what precedes it; the preposition «على حياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحرص». The preposition «من الذين» is attached to «أحرص» understood; it falls under the elative, and (the elative) was omitted from the second because the first indicates it, i.e. "and more eager than those who associate partners". «لو يعمر»: «لو» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «يود», i.e. "his being given long life". «ألف»: an adverb of time attached to «يعمر». The wāw in «وما» is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما» works like laysa, and the pronoun «هو», referring back to the preceding «أحد», is its noun; the bāʾ in «بمزحزحه» is redundant (zāʾida), and «مزحزحه» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «من العذاب» is attached to «مزحزحه», and the maṣdar «أن يعمر» is the fāʿil (agent) of «بمزحزحه»; the implied form is "and one of them — his being given long life will not remove him".

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كان» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "there is no reason for his enmity". The apodosis cannot be «فإنه نزله», because the clause of requital does not contain a pronoun referring to the conditional noun. The preposition «لجبريل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو». The clause «فإنه نزله» is resumptive. The preposition «بإذن الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نزله». The lām in «لما» is redundant (zāʾida), strengthening the transitivity of «مصدِّقا» to what it governs, and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The clause «كان» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «مَن». The clause «فإن الله عدو» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the link between the condition and the apodosis is the generality in «الكافرين», under which the first is included. The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو».

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «وما يكفر بها» is conjoined to the clause «أنزلنا», with no grammatical position. «الفاسقون» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يكفر», and the exception is emptied (mufarragh).

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The hamza is interrogative, and the wāw is for conjunction; the hamza was placed before it because it has the right to the head of the clause. «كل» is accusative as an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نبذ», and «ما» is a temporal maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the implied form is "a party threw it aside at every time of making a covenant". «عهدا»: substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being معاهدة. The clause «نبذه فريق» is conjoined to the preceding clause {أَنْزَلْنَا}, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «مصدق» is a naʿt (adjective), nominative; the non-explicit (clausal/phrasal) adjective has come before the explicit one. «لما»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), strengthening the transitivity of «مصدق» to its object, and «ما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «كأنهم لا يعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فريق».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «وما كفر سليمان» is resumptive; the clause «ولكن الشياطين كفروا» is conjoined to the clause «كفر», and the clause «يعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «كفروا», in the position of the accusative. «السحر»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and his words «وما أنزل» are conjoined to «السحر». «هاروت»: badal (substitute) from «الملكين». The clause «وما يعلمان» is conjoined to the clause «يعلمون», in the position of the accusative; the clause «فلا تكفر» is conjoined to the clause «إنما نحن فتنة»; and the clause «فيتعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «وما يعلمان». The clause «وما هم بضارين» is a ḥāl from the wāw of «يفرقون», in the position of the accusative. The clause «ويتعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «فيتعلمون». His words «من أحد»: object of the active participle, «مِن» being redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «بإذن الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from the latent pronoun in «ضارين». The clause «ولقد علموا» is resumptive, and the lām introduces the response to the implied oath. The lām in «لمن» is for emphasis; «مَن» is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «خلاق» is a mubtadaʾ, «مِن» being redundant; and the preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to a ḥāl from «خلاق». The clause «لمن اشتراه» stands in place of the two objects of «علم», and the clause «ما له من خلاق» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative «مَن». The clause «ولبئس ما شروا» is resumptive; the lām introduces the response to an omitted oath; «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil; and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "sorcery". The clause «لو كانوا يعلمون» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "they would not have sold themselves for it".

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أنَّ» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied "were established" (ثبت), and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, i.e. "they would have been rewarded"; a nominal clause does not occur as the apodosis of «لو». «لمثوبة»: the lām is that of inception (ibtidāʾ); «مثوبة» is mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being «خير»; the clause is resumptive. The apodosis of the second «لو» is omitted, i.e. "it would have been better". The clause «لو كانوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أيها», in the position of the accusative [Translator's note: so in the source]. The clause «وللكافرين عذاب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The preposition «من أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين كفروا». The maṣdar «أن ينزل» is the object of «يود»; «مِن» in «من خير» is redundant (zāʾida), and «خير» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition «من ربكم» is attached to «خير». The clause «والله يختص» is resumptive, and the clause «والله ذو الفضل» is conjoined to the clause «والله يختص», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «ما ننسخ من آية»: «ما» is a jussive conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. The preposition «من آية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «ما»; «مِن» is not redundant, because the condition is affirmative. Attaching it to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما» is weak, because the meaning is "whatever thing of the verses We abrogate". The preposition «منها» is attached to «خير». «أنَّ الله ...» is a maṣdar standing in place of the two objects of «تعلم». The clause «ألم تعلم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The clause «له ملك» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنّ». The clause «وما لكم من ولي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida) in the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ولي», because when a naʿt (adjective) precedes the noun it qualifies, it becomes a ḥāl from it.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «أم»: the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning "rather" (بل) plus the hamza; the clause with it is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «تريدون». «كما»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a questioning like the questioning"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «سواء» is an adverb of place meaning "middle".

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «لو» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «ودَّ»; «كفارا» is a second object. «حسدا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition «من عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حسدا». «ما» is maṣdariyya in his words «ما تبيَّن», and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «فاعفوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «وما تقدِّموا» is resumptive; «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. The preposition «من خير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما», and the adverb «عند» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «تجدوه».

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: «من» is a relative, fāʿil (agent). The clause «تلك أمانيهم» is resumptive, and so is the clause «قل هاتوا». «هاتوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is joined to the wāw, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «بلى»: a particle of answer; «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «أسلم» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «وهو محسن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of "being established" to which the khabar is attached. The clause «ولا خوف عليهم» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The clause «وهم يتلون الكتاب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «اليهود». The clause «قال الذين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they said a saying like that saying". «ذا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «مثل» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "they said a saying like their saying". The clause «فالله يحكم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The clause «ومن أظلم» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun — its meaning is negation — mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أظلم» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم». The interpreted maṣdar from «أن يذكر» is in the position of the accusative as the second object of «منع». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يدخلوها» is the noun of kāna, and «خائفين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يدخلوها». (The construction) first followed the wording of «مَنْ», so it is singular in his words «منع» and «سعى», and secondly followed its meaning, so it is plural in his words «أولئك». The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to a ḥāl from «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: «فأينما»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; the fāʾ has conjoined the clause to the resumptive one before it, as a case of conjoining the effect to the cause. «أينما» is a jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تولوا», and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the verb is jussive by the dropping of the nūn. The fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ثم» is a demonstrative for the distant, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, an adverb of place attached to the implied khabar (predicate), and «وجه» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later.

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: «سبحانه» is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause with it is resumptive; so is the clause «بل له ما في السماوات», and so is the clause «كل له قانتون»; the preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قانتون».

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «بديع»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is the Originator", and the clause is resumptive. The clause «وإذا قضى» is conjoined to the clause «هو بديع السماوات», with no grammatical position; «إذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis, the implied form being "the thing comes to be when He decrees it". «كن فيكون»: (كن) is a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "you"; the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause «يكون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "so it comes to be" (فهو يكون); the clause «هو يكون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The wāw has conjoined the clause «وقال الذين» to the clause {وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ} in verse (116). «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the kāf in «كذلك» is a noun meaning "like", a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they said a saying like that". «مثل»: mafʿūl muṭlaq of the verb «قال», i.e. "they said a saying like their saying". The clause «تشابهت قلوبهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and so is the clause «قد بينَّا». The clause «يوقنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object in «أرسلناك», i.e. "bound up with the truth". The clause «ولا تُسْأل» is conjoined to the clause «إنا أرسلناك», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: The clause «ولن ترضى عنك اليهود» is conjoined to the preceding clause {وَلا تُسْأَلُ}. The pronoun «هو» in his words «هو الهدى» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. «ولئن اتبعت»: the wāw is resumptive; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and «إن» is a jussive conditional; the preposition «من العلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءك». The clause «ما لك من الله من ولي» is the response to the implied oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath. «ولي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «يتلونه». «حق» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «أولئك يؤمنون به» is resumptive, and so is the clause «ومن يكفر».

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: The maṣdar «وأني فضلتكم» is conjoined to «نعمتي», i.e. "remember My favour and My preferring (you)".

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: The clause «واتقوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause {اذْكُرُوا}. The clause «لا تجزي» is a naʿt (adjective), and the link between the adjective and the qualified noun is implied, i.e. "in it". «شيئا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "will not avail any availing, little or much". The clause «ولا هم ينصرون» is conjoined to the clause «لا تنفعها شفاعة».

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is the object of an implied "remember", and the clause «ابتلى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «إماما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «جاعلك». The preposition «ومن ذريتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of an omitted qualified noun which is the first object; the second object and the governor are both omitted, the implied form being "and make a group that is of my offspring imams". The clause «ومن ذريتي», together with what is omitted from it, is the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: «واتخذوا من مقام إبراهيم مصلى»: this clause is parenthetical between the two clauses «جعلنا» and «عهدنا». The preposition «من مقام» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object of «اتخذ». «أن» in «أن طَهِّرا» is explicative (mufassira), because it is preceded by a verb having the meaning of saying without its letters; the clause with it is explicative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: «من آمن»: «مَنْ» is a badal (substitute) from «أهله», in the position of the accusative, and the preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «آمن». The second «مَنْ» is a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "and I will provide for whoever disbelieves"; the speech is implied, i.e. "He said: I will provide for him, and I will provide for whoever disbelieves". The clause «فأمتعه» is conjoined to the implied one, i.e. "I will provide for whoever disbelieves, and I will give him enjoyment". «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "the Fire", and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «ربنا تقبل منا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) with the saying implied, and that saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "saying". The clause «تقبَّل» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; likewise the clause «إنك أنت السميع» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «إنك».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The clause «ربنا» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and the clause «واجعلنا» is conjoined to the preceding clause «تقبَّل». The preposition «من ذريتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of an omitted qualified noun which is the first object, the implied form being "and make a group that is of our offspring a nation submitting (to You)". «أمة» is the second object of the implied verb.

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: The clause «ربنا» is parenthetical, and the clause «وابعث» is conjoined to the clause «وتب». The clause «يتلو» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسولا».

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: The clause «ومن يرغب» is resumptive; «مَن» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يرغب» is the khabar (predicate). (The second) «مَن» is a relative noun, badal (substitute) from the pronoun in «يرغب», and «نفسه» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because «سفه نفسه» means "debased it". The clause «لقد اصطفيناه» is the response to an implied oath. The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الصالحين»; what is tolerated for a genitive phrase is not tolerated for others. The clause «وإنه في الآخرة ...» is conjoined to the response to the oath, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second «قال», i.e. "he said: I have submitted, at the time when Allah said to him: submit". The second clause «قال» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:132-132.t: The clause «يا بني إن الله» is explicative of the bequest. His words «فلا تموتن»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if the matter is so, then do not…"; «لا» is prohibitive and jussive-governing, and the verb is jussive by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs. The second nūn has remained, for emphasis. When the nūn of the indicative was dropped, two vowelless letters met: the wāw and the first, assimilated nūn; so the wāw was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and the ḍamma remained to indicate it. The verb has not become indeclinable (mabnī) despite the attachment of the nūn of emphasis to it, because the nūn is not directly attached to it, owing to the implied separator, namely the wāw. The clause «وأنتم مسلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied wāw in «تموتن».

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: «أم»: the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning "rather" (بل) plus the hamza. «إذ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهداء», and the second «إذ» is a badal (substitute) from the first. «إبراهيم» is a badal from «آبائك», and «إلها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. The clause «ونحن له مسلمون» is a ḥāl, in the position of the accusative, from the fāʿil (agent) of «نعبد».

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: The clause «قد خلت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمة». The clause «لها ما كسبت» is resumptive; it would have been fit to be a second adjective of «أمة», but it is resumptive because the clause «ما كسبتم» lacks the link that would tie it to the qualified noun. The clause «لا تسألون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: «تهتدوا»: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are (Jews or Christians), you will be guided". «ملة»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb, its implied form being "we follow". «حنيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إبراهيم»; the ḥāl has come from the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) because the muḍāf is like a part of the muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وما كان» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «حنيفا».

harrat-mujtaba:136-136.t: The clause «لا نفرِّق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «النبيون», and the clause «ونحن له مسلمون» is conjoined to the clause «لا نفرق», in the position of the accusative. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «مسلمون».

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: The fāʾ in «فسيكفيكهم» is resumptive. The clause «وهو السميع» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:138-138.t: «صبغَةَ»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "we have been dyed", and the interrogative clause is parenthetical. «صبغةً» (the second) is tamyīz (specification), because the accusative noun after the elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) occurs as a tamyīz. The clause «ونحن له عابدون» is conjoined to the implied verbal clause «صُبِغنا».

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: The clause «وهو ربنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «أتحاجوننا»; the clause «ولنا أعمالنا» is conjoined to the clause «هو ربنا», in the position of the accusative; and the clause «ونحن له مخلصون» is conjoined to the clause «لكم أعمالكم».

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: «أم» is a conjunction, and the name of Majesty is conjoined to «أنتم», nominative with ḍamma. The clause «ومن أظلم» is resumptive; the preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم»; the adverb «عنده» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شهادة»; the preposition «من الله» is attached to the notion of "being established" to which «عنده» is attached. The clause «وما الله بغافل» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:141-141.t: See the i'rab of verse (134). The verb «خلت» was originally خَلَوَتْ: the wāw took a vowel and the letter before it took fatḥa, so it was changed into alif; then two vowelless letters met, so the final radical (lām al-fiʿl) was dropped; its pattern is فَعَتْ.
