harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «ولاهم» is the khabar (predicate); the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «يهدي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form is "We made you with a making like that making", and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وما جعلنا القبلة» is resumptive. His words «التي كنت عليها»: a relative noun, second object; the implied form is "and We did not make the qibla the direction which you were on". The maṣdar «لنعلم» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلنا». The preposition «على عقبيه» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ينقلب». The clause «وإن كانت لكبيرة» is resumptive; «إن» is lightened from the heavy (inna) and is inoperative, and the lām after it is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa). The preposition «على الذين» is attached to «كبيرة». The clause «وما كان الله» is resumptive; the lām in «ليضيع» is that of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and what follows it is genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the implied khabar (predicate) of kāna: "wishing". The preposition «بالناس» is attached to «رؤوف».

harrat-mujtaba:144-144.t: The preposition «في السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (تَقَلُّب). The fāʾ in «فلنولِّينك» is a conjunction, linking the effect to the cause, and the implied clause «نقسم» (We swear) is conjoined to the clause «نرى», with no grammatical position. The clause «لنولِّينك» is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. «قبلة» is a second object. The clause «فولِّ» is resumptive, and «شطر» is a second object. «وحيثما كنتم فولُّوا وجوهكم شطره»: the clause is resumptive. «حيثما» is a jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to the complete (tāmm) «كنتم», and «شطره» is a second object. The clause «وإن الذين أوتوا» is resumptive; the preposition «من ربهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق»; and the clause «وما الله بغافل» is resumptive. The bāʾ in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which works like laysa, is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: The wāw is resumptive; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and «إن» is conditional. The clause «ما تبعوا» is the response to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath. The second oath has as its response «إنك إذا لمن الظالمين». «ما» in «ما جاءك» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «إذًا» is an inoperative particle of answer, and the lām in «لمن» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: His words «كما يعرفون»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The implied form is "they know him with a knowing like their knowing of their sons". The wāw in «وإنَّ فريقا» is circumstantial, and the clause with it is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and likewise the clause «وهم يعلمون».

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: The clause «فلا تكونن» is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it; the implied form is "so do not be among those who doubt it".

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: The clause «هو مُوَلِّيها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «وِجهة». The clause «فاستبقوا» is resumptive. «أينما» is a jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the complete (tāmm) «تكونوا», and «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: The wāw is a conjunction, and «حيث» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وَلِّ», and the clause «خَرجت» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The fāʾ in «فَوَلِّ» is redundant (zāʾida), and the verb is transitive to two objects: «وجهك» and «شطر». The clause «ولِّ» is conjoined to the clause «استبقوا», in the position of the jussive, and the clause «وإنه للحق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: The wāw is resumptive; «حيثما» is a jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the complete (tāmm) «كنتم». «فوَلُّوا»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The interpreted maṣdar «لئلا يكون» is genitive, (the two) attached to «وَلُّوا». The preposition «عليكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حجة»; it was originally an adjective, and when it came first it became a ḥāl. «إلا الذين» is a disjoined excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. The clause «فلا تخشوهم» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if they are like that, then do not…". The interpreted maṣdar «لأتمَّ» is genitive, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar «لئلا يكون», attached to «وَلُّوا»; the separation between the two reasons does no harm, because (what separates them) belongs to what is attached to the first reason. The clause «لعلكم تهتدون» is conjoined to a single word, in the position of the genitive, i.e. "and for the completion of My favour, and that you may be guided".

harrat-mujtaba:151-151.t: The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "and that I may complete My favour upon you with a completion like the sending of the Messenger among you". The clause «يتلو» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسولا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: «تكفرون»: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is that of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the object of the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: «أيها»: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; «ها» is for alerting, and «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause «إن الله مع الصابرين» is parenthetical between the two conjoined verbs.

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t: «أموات»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they"; likewise «أحياء». The clause «لكن لا تشعرون» is conjoined to the implied clause of saying, i.e. "rather say: they are alive", and the implied clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of «الصابرين». «إذا»: adverbial, conditional, non-jussive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا». The conditional clause and its apodosis (jawāb) are the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: The clause «عليهم صلوات» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك». The preposition «من ربهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «صلوات». The clause «وأولئك هم المهتدون» is conjoined to the clause «أولئك عليهم صلوات».

harrat-mujtaba:158-158.t: «أن يطَّوَّف بهما»: the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and what follows it is accusative by removal of the preposition «في». His words «خيرا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the original is "a good voluntary act" (تطوُّعا خيرا). The clause «ومن تطوَّع» is conjoined to the clause «فمن حجَّ البيت», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: The preposition «من البينات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». (The other) «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "after Our making it clear". The clause «أولئك يلعنهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:160-160.t: The clause «فأولئك أتوب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «أتوب» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). The clause «وأنا التواب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: «أولئك» is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ «لعنة». The clause «عليهم لعنة الله» is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ «أولئك», and the clause «أولئك عليهم لعنة» is the khabar of «إن». «أجمعين» is tawkīd (emphasis), genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليهم», and the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». The clause «لا يخفف» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «خالدين». The clause «ولا هم ينظرون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يخفف», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: «لا إله إلا هو»: «لا» is that of generic negation, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship"; «إلا» is for restriction, and «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar; the clause is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject). «الرحمن الرحيم» are two khabars of the mubtadaʾ «إلهكم».

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: The lām is for emphasis, and «آيات» is the noun of «إن» placed later, accusative with kasra; the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». The clause «يعقلون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: The clause «يحبونهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أندادا», and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they love them with a love like the love of Allah"; «حب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «والذين آمنوا أشد حبا لله» is parenthetical, and «حبًّا» is tamyīz (specification). The clause «ولو يرى الذين ظلموا» is conjoined to the clause «من الناس من يتخذ», with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar «أن القوة» stands in place of the two objects of «يرى», and «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun in the implied khabar (predicate); the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first maṣdar. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

harrat-mujtaba:166-166.t: «إذ تبرأ»: «إذ» is an adverbial noun, badal (substitute) from {إِذْ يَرَوْنَ}, and the clause «ورأوا العذاب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «وتقطَّعت بهم الأسباب» is conjoined to the clause «رأوا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:167-167.t: The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أنَّ» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» (were established). «فنتبرأ»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and the verb is an imperfect, accusative by «أن» implied after the causative fāʾ, in response to the wish that accompanies the conditional «لو»; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "we would have disowned (them)". The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "if a return for us were established, and (thus) our disowning them". «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "He shows them with a showing like that"; the seeing is visual, transitive to two (objects) through the hamza of transfer. «حسرات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أعمالهم», and the preposition «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حسرات». The clause «يريهم» is resumptive, and the clause «وما هم بخارجين» is conjoined to the clause «يريهم الله».

harrat-mujtaba:168-168.t: «الناس» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أي». The clause «كلوا» is resumptive; «مما» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلوا»; «حلالا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is originally an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "eat lawful food". The preposition «لكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عدو»; it is an adjective that has come before its qualified noun. The clause «إنه لكم عدو» is resumptive, within the scope of the response to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:169-169.t: «وأن تقولوا» is conjoined to «السوء», i.e. "he commands you to evil and to saying about Allah…". «ما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:170-170.t: The clause «بل نتَّبع» is resumptive. The hamza in «أولو» is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); it came before the wāw because the hamza has the right to the head of the clause. The wāw is circumstantial, conjoining to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial), and what is conjoined to a ḥāl is a ḥāl; the clause «كان آباؤهم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "they follow their fathers in every state, even if they did not understand". «شيئا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:171-171.t: The preposition «كمثل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate); the implied form is "their likeness is as the likeness". «صم»: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they"; «بكم» and «عمي» are two further khabars. The clause «فهم لا يعقلون» is conjoined to the clause «هم صمٌّ», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:172-172.t: The clause «إن كنتم إياه تعبدون» is resumptive. «إيَّاه» is an accusative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the hāʾ is for the third person. The clause «تعبدون» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:173-173.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «اضطر» is the khabar (predicate), «غير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «إن الله غفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:174-174.t: The preposition «من الكتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». The clause «أولئك ما يأكلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause «ولا يكلمهم» is conjoined to the clause «ما يأكلون»; and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «لا يكلمهم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:175-175.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and «ما» is a complete (tāmma) indefinite of wonder (taʿajjub), mubtadaʾ (subject); «أصبرهم» is a past verb, and the clause is resumptive; the clause «أصبرهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:176-176.t: The interpreted maṣdar «بأن الله» is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «وإن الذين اختلفوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:177-177.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن تُوَلُّوا» is the noun of «ليس», and «قِبل» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تُوَلوا». The clause «ولكن البرَّ من آمن» is conjoined to the clause «ليس البر أن تولوا», with no grammatical position. «ذوي»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. The preposition «في الرقاب» is attached to «آتى», on its being made to include the meaning of «وضع» (to place). «الموفون»: a noun conjoined to «من آمن», nominative with wāw. «إذا عاهدوا»: an adverb stripped of the meaning of condition, attached to «الموفون». «الصابرين»: mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "I praise", and the clause «وأمدح» is conjoined to the resumptive «ليس البر من آمن» [Translator's note: so in the source]. «حين»: an adverb attached to «الصابرين». The clause «أولئك الذين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:178-178.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أيها». The clause «كتب عليكم القصاص» is resumptive, the response to the vocative. The preposition «في القتلى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب», and the clause «الحر بالحر» is explicative of «القصاص», with no grammatical position. The clause «فمن عفي له شيء» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. His words «فاتباع»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then the ruling is…"; the preposition «بالمعروف» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «اتباع». The clause «ذلك تخفيف» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:179-179.t: The two clauses «يا أولي الألباب» and «لعلكم تتقون» are resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:180-180.t: «إذا»: an adverb stripped of (the meaning of) condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب»; «الموت» is the fāʿil (agent) placed later, and «الوصية» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «إن ترك خيرا» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the context indicates it. The preposition «بالمعروف» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الوصية». «حقا على المتقين»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a prescribing as a duty", and the preposition «على المتقين» is attached to a naʿt of «حقا».

harrat-mujtaba:181-181.t: The clause «فمن بدَّله» is conjoined to the clause «كتب عليكم الوصية», with no grammatical position. «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «بدَّله» is the khabar (predicate); «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «سمعه» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative; «سميع عليم» are two khabars of the abrogating «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:183-183.t: His words «كما كُتب»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "it has been prescribed with a prescribing like its prescribing"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «لعلكم تتقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:184-184.t: «أياما» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "fast"; it is not made accusative by the preceding «الصيام», because of an extraneous separator between the maṣdar and what it governs, namely his words «كما كتب». The adjective of what is non-rational may be put in the plural with alif and tāʾ, and the singular is also permissible, as in أيام معدودات and معدودة. The preposition «على سفر» is attached to an implied word conjoined to «مريضا», i.e. "or being on a journey". His words «فعدَّة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then what is obligatory is a number", and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «أُخَر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أيام», a diptote. The clause «وعلى الذين يطيقونه فدية» is conjoined to the clause «من كان منكم مريضا»; «طعام» is a badal (substitute) from «فدية»; and «خيرا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The interpreted maṣdar «وأن تصوموا خير لكم»: mubtadaʾ, and «خير» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The clause «إن كنتم تعلمون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:185-185.t: «شهر»: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; its khabar (predicate) is the relative noun. «هدى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرآن». The clause «فمن شهد» is resumptive, and the clause «فليصمه» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is the pronoun of the adverb, in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in it". His words «ولتكملوا»: the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, its implied form being "He has legislated". The implied clause «وشرع» is conjoined to the clause «يريد», with no grammatical position. The clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the maṣdar «للتكبير» [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse has «ولتكبروا»], as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:186-186.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «أجيب» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن». «إذا» in his words «إذا دعان» is an adverb stripped of (the meaning of) condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أُجيب». The clause «فإني قريب» is the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, i.e. "then say to them: I am near"; the implied clause «فقل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «فليستجيبوا» is resumptive, and the clause «لعلهم يرشدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:187-187.t: The adverb «ليلة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أُحِلَّ»; «الرفثُ» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the preposition «إلى نسائكم» is attached to the maṣdar (الرفث), made to include the meaning of «الإفضاء» (going in unto). The clause «هُنَّ لباس» is resumptive, and the preposition «لكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «لباس». The clause «علم الله» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar «أنكم كنتم» stands in place of the object of «علم» in the sense of «عرف» (to know), so it is transitive to one (object). His words «فالآن»: an adverb of time attached to «باشروهنَّ». The preposition «من الخيط» is attached to «يتبيَّن», and the preposition «من الفجر» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الخيط الأبيض». The clause «وأنتم عاكفون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «تباشروهن», and the clause «تلك حدود» is resumptive. The clause «فلا تقربوها» is conjoined to the resumptive «تلك حدود». The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "He makes clear with a making-clear like that making-clear". The clause «لعلهم يتقون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:188-188.t: His words «وتدلوا بها»: the wāw is that of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and the verb is an imperfect, accusative by «أن» necessarily implied after the wāw; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, the implied form being "let there be no eating of wealth together with conveying it (to the judges)". The maṣdar «لتأكلوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تدلوا». The preposition «بالإثم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «تأكلوا», i.e. "bound up with sin". The clause «وأنتم تعلمون» is a ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:189-189.t: The bāʾ in «بأن تأتوا» is redundant (zāʾida), and the interpreted maṣdar is the khabar (predicate) of laysa. The clause «ليس البر» is resumptive, and the clause «ولكن البر من اتقى» is conjoined to the clause «ليس البر بأن تأتوا». His words «مَنْ» is the khabar of «لكن», on the assumption that the muḍāf is omitted, i.e. "the righteousness of whoever…". The clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:190-190.t: The clause «وقاتلوا» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إن الله لا يحب المعتدين». His words «تعتدوا»: its original is تَعْتَدِوُوا; the wāw occurred as the final radical (lām) with kasra before it, so it was changed into yāʾ, and it became تعتدِيُوا; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was dropped; then two vowelless letters met, so the final radical was dropped, and the letter before the wāw took ḍamma.

harrat-mujtaba:191-191.t: The clause «ثقفتموهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «حيث» is an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اقتلوهم». The clause «والفتنة أشدُّ من القتل» is parenthetical between the two conjoined (clauses), and the clause «فإن قاتلوكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The kāf in «كذلك» is a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «جزاء»; the clause «كذلك جزاء الكافرين» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:192-192.t: The clause «فإن انتهوا» is conjoined to the clause {فَإِنْ قَاتَلُوكُمْ}, with no grammatical position, and «غفور رحيم» are two khabars (predicates) of the abrogating «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:193-193.t: «حتى» is a particle of limit and a preposition, and «تكون» is a complete (tāmm) imperfect, accusative by «أن» necessarily implied after «حتى»; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قاتلوهم». The clause «فإن انتهوا» is conjoined to the clause «وقاتلوهم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:196-196.t: The clause «فإن أُحصرتم» is conjoined to the clause «أتموا», with no grammatical position. The fāʾ in «فما استيسر» introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "then upon him is…". The clause «فمن كان منكم مريضا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تحلقوا», with no grammatical position. His words «أذى»: mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun «به» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; the clause «أو به أذى» is conjoined to the single word «مريضا», in the position of the accusative. The clause «فعليه فدية» is the apodosis of a jussive condition, and the clause «فإذا أمنتم» is conjoined to the clause «فمن كان منكم». The clause «فمن تمتع فما استيسر» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. The preposition «إلى الحج» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تمتَّع». His words «فصيام»: mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is implied, i.e. "then upon him"; the preposition «في الحج» is attached to the notion of "being established" to which the khabar of «صيام» is attached; the implied form is "then a fast of three days is upon him during the Hajj". «إذا رجعتم» is an adverb stripped of (the meaning of) condition, attached to the notion of "being established" to which the khabar of «صيام» is attached; the implied form is "and a fast of seven days is upon him when he returns". The clause «رجعتم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of the genitive. The clause «واتقوا الله» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن الله شديد العقاب» stands in place of the two objects of «علم».

harrat-mujtaba:197-197.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «فرض» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «وما تفعلوا» is resumptive; «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition «مِنْ خير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «ما». The clause «وما تفعلوا» is resumptive, and so are the two clauses «تزوَّدوا» and «إن خير الزاد التقوى». «أولي» is the one addressed (munādā), accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:198-198.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن تبتغوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فضلا», and the clause «فإذا أفضتم» is resumptive. The clause «واذكروه» is conjoined to the clause «فاذكروا», with no grammatical position. The kāf in «كما» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "and remember Him with a good remembrance, like His guiding you with good guidance"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وإن كنتم من قبله لمن الضالين» is resumptive; «إن» is lightened from the heavy (inna) and is inoperative, and the lām after it is the one distinguishing between the negative (in) and the lightened (in). The preposition «من قبله» is attached to «الضالين», according to the view of those who allow latitude with prepositional phrases, and so let what comes after the relative «أل» in «الضالِّين» govern what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:199-199.t: The clause «ثم أفيضوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause {وَاذْكُرُوهُ}, with no grammatical position. «حيث» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by «مِنْ», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أفيضوا». «غفور رحيم» are two khabars (predicates) of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:200-200.t: His words «فاذكروا»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a remembrance like your remembrance", and «ذكركم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His words «آباءكم»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «ذكر»; «أشد» is a noun conjoined to «ذكركم», the implied form being "or like a remembrance stronger in remembrance", and «ذكرا» is tamyīz (specification). The clause «فمن الناس....» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «وما له في الآخرة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «خلاق» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:201-201.t: In his words «آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة»: the wāw has conjoined two governed words to two governed words: it conjoined «في الآخرة» to «في الدنيا», and conjoined the second «حسنة» to the first «حسنة». The clause «آتنا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:202-202.t: The clause «لهم نصيب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The maṣdar «مما كسبوا» is genitive by «من», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «نصيب». The clause «والله سريع الحساب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:203-203.t: The clause «واذكروا» is resumptive, and the clause «فمن تعجَّل» is conjoined to the resumptive one. His words «لمن اتقى»: the lām is a preposition, and «من» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the absence of sin is for whoever is mindful (of Allah)"; the clause is parenthetical between the imperative verbs. The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «علم».

harrat-mujtaba:204-204.t: The clause «ويشهد» is conjoined to the clause «يعجبك». The preposition «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (قوله). The clause «وهو ألدُّ الخصام» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:205-205.t: The conditional clause «وإذا تولَّى» is conjoined to the clause «يشهد», with no grammatical position. The clause «والله لا يحب الفساد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:206-206.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar, i.e. "the saying was said". His words «ولبئس المهاد»: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām introduces the response to the oath; «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for blame, and «المهاد» is the fāʿil (agent); the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "Hell".

harrat-mujtaba:208-208.t: «أيها»: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for alerting. «الذين»: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أي». «كافة»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ادخلوا». The clause «إنه لكم عدو» is resumptive, within the scope of the response to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:209-209.t: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:210-210.t: «إلا» is for restriction, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «ينظرون». The clause «وقضي الأمر» is conjoined to the clause «يأتيهم», with no grammatical position. The clause «ترجع الأمور» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:211-211.t: «كم»: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the second object of «آتيناهم». The preposition «من آية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». The clause «كم آتيناهم» is the second object of the asking, in the position of the accusative; the verb «سل», even though it is not a verb of the heart, is a means to knowledge, and knowledge can be suspended (from governing).

harrat-mujtaba:212-212.t: The clause «ويسخرون» is conjoined to the clause «زُيّن», with no grammatical position. The clause «الذين اتقوا فوقهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:213-213.t: The clause «وما اختلف فيه إلا الذين أوتوه» is parenthetical. «بغيا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative. His words «لما اختلفوا»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «هدى». The clause «فهدى الله» is conjoined to the clause «وأنزل».

harrat-mujtaba:214-214.t: «أم»: the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one; the implied form is "rather, did you think…". His words «ولما يأتكم»: the wāw is circumstantial; «لمَّا» is a jussive-governing particle, and the verb after it is jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «مسَّتهم البأساء» is explicative of «المثل», with no grammatical position. «متى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). «نصر الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later, and «الله» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:215-215.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). «ذا»: a relative noun meaning "that which", its khabar (predicate). The clause «ينفقون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, with no grammatical position, and the clause «ماذا ينفقون» is the second object of the asking. His words «ما أنفقتم من خير»: «ما» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the preposition «من خير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «ما». The preposition «فللوالدين» is attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "its proper use is for the parents". «وما تفعلوا»: «ما» is a jussive conditional, mafʿūl bihi, and the preposition «من خير» is attached to an adjective of «ما». The clause «وما تفعلوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:216-216.t: The clause «وهو كره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القتال». His words «وعسى أن تكرهوا شيئا»: the wāw is resumptive; «عسى» is a complete (tāmm) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the maṣdar «أن تكرهوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «عسى». The clause «وهو خير لكم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from «شيئا»; a ḥāl from an indefinite is permitted because of the presence of the wāw. The clause «والله يعلم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «وأنتم لا تعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «والله يعلم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:217-217.t: «قتال»: badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion), genitive with kasra, and the preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قتال». «قتال» (the second): mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it is qualified by «فيه». «المسجد»: a noun conjoined to «سبيل», genitive. His words «أكبر»: khabar (predicate) of «صدّ» and the conjoined words with it, and the clause «والفتنة أكبر من القتل» is conjoined to the clause «وصد عن سبيل الله أكبر». The clause «ولا يزالون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and so is the clause «إن استطاعوا»; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وهو كافر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar of the second mubtadaʾ «أولئك», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:218-218.t: The clause «أولئك يرجون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause «والله غفور» is resumptive. «رحيم» is a second khabar of the name of Majesty.

harrat-mujtaba:219-219.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun meaning "that which", khabar (predicate); the clause «ماذا ينفقون» is the second object of the asking. «العفو»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb, i.e. "spend the surplus", and the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "He makes clear with a making-clear like that making-clear". The clause «يبيِّن» is resumptive, and so is the clause «لعلكم تتفكرون».

harrat-mujtaba:220-220.t: The preposition «في الدنيا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {تَتَفَكَّرُونَ} in the previous verse. «إصلاح»: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; what permitted beginning with an indefinite is its being qualified by the prepositional phrase after it. His words «فإخوانكم»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then they are your brothers", and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive. The clause «والله يعلم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:221-221.t: His words «ولأمة مؤمنة خيرٌ من مشركة»: the wāw is parenthetical, and the lām is that of inception (ibtidāʾ); «أمة» is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the clause is parenthetical between the verbs of prohibition. «ولو»: the wāw is circumstantial, conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied form is "better than a polytheist woman in every state, even in this state"; this is for covering all states exhaustively. The clause «ولو أعجبتكم» is a ḥāl, in the position of the accusative. The clause «لعلهم يتذكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:222-222.t: The clause «فاعتزلوا» is conjoined to the clause «هو أذى». The verb is an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is joined to the wāw, and the wāw is an attached pronoun, fāʿil (agent). The clause «أمركم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), because it comes after the adverb «حيث». The clause «إن الله يحب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:223-223.t: The clause «نساؤكم حرث» is resumptive. The clause «فأتوا حرثكم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it. «أنى» is a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شئتم»; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, its implied form being "wherever you wish, then come", and the clause «أنَّى شئتم» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «علم». The clause «وبشِّر المؤمنين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:224-224.t: The preposition «لأيمانكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عرضة». The interpreted maṣdar «أن تبروا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the implied form is "wishing that you be righteous". The clause «تبروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, with no grammatical position. The clause «والله سميع عليم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:225-225.t: «بما كسبت»: the bāʾ is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤاخذكم». The clause «والله غفور» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:226-226.t: The clause «فإن فاءوا» is conjoined to the clause «للذين يؤلون تربُّص», with no grammatical position. «غفور رحيم» are two khabars (predicates) of the name of Majesty, nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:228-228.t: His words «ثلاثة قروء»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتربَّصنَ». The clause «ولا يحل أن يكتمن» is conjoined to the nominal clause «المطلقات يتربَّصن». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يكتمن» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يحلُّ». The clause «إن كنَّ يؤمنَّ» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «إن أرادوا إصلاحا» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. The clause «وللرجال عليهن درجة» is conjoined to the clause «ولهنَّ مثلُ», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:229-229.t: His words «فإمساكٌ بمعروف»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then what is obligatory is retaining in kindness", and the clause «فالواجب إمساك» is conjoined to the clause «الطلاق مرتان». His words «إلا أن يخافا»: «إلا» is for restriction, and the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the meaning is: it is not lawful for you to take (anything) for any reason except the fear of not upholding the limits of Allah, for that is what makes the taking permissible for you. The other maṣdar «ألا يقيما» is the object of «خاف». The clause «فإن خفتم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «فلا تعتدوها» is conjoined to the clause «تلك حدود الله». «هم» in his words «هم الظالمون» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:230-230.t: The clause «فلا تحلُّ» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then she is not lawful", and the nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive; the clause «فلا تحلُّ» itself cannot be the apodosis, because «لا» is not one of the places (that require) the fāʾ. His words «غيره»: naʿt (adjective) of «زوجا», accusative with fatḥa. The interpreted maṣdar «أن يتراجعا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «إن ظنا أن يقيما» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يقيما» stands in place of the two objects of «ظنَّ». The clause «يبيِّنها» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حدود الله».

harrat-mujtaba:231-231.t: His words «ولا تُمسِكوهن ضرارا لتعتدوا»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive and jussive-governing, and the verb is an imperfect in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs. «ضرارا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the interpreted maṣdar «لتعتدوا» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تمسكوا». The clause «ومَن يفعل ذلك فقد ظلم نفسه» is parenthetical between the verbs of prohibition. His words «هزوا»: second object, accusative; the preposition «من الكتاب» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». The clause «يعظكم» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «أنزل», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:232-232.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن ينكحن» is accusative by removal of the preposition «مِن». «إذا» is an adverb stripped of (the meaning of) condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينكحن». «تراضوا»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters after the yāʾ was made vowelless; the original is تراضَيُوا, and the wāw is an attached pronoun, fāʿil (agent). His words «ذلك يوعظ به من كان منكم»: «مَنْ» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «يوعظ», and the preposition «منكم» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «يؤمن». The clause «يؤمن» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of kāna. The clause «ذلكم أزكى لكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:233-233.t: «حولين»: an adverb of time, accusative with yāʾ because it is dual, and «كاملين» is a naʿt (adjective). «لمن»: the lām is a preposition, and «من» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "that is for whoever…". The maṣdar «أن يتم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «أراد», i.e. "wishes its completion". The clause «لا تكلف نفس» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and so is the clause «لا تضارَّ والدة». «وُسعها» is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. The verb «تضارَّ» is jussive and passive; the sign of its jussive is sukūn, and it has been given fatḥa because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. «إذا سلّمتم»: «إذا» is attached to the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb), and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you pay, there is no blame on you". The two objects of «آتيتم» are omitted, i.e. "what you have given them (of it)".

harrat-mujtaba:234-234.t: The clause «يتربَّصن» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين»; the implied form is "and the wives of those who die wait". «أربعة أشهر»: accusative as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتربصن». The preposition «فيما فعلن» is attached to the notion of "being established" to which the khabar is attached. The clause «فإذا بلغن» is conjoined to the clause «والذين يتوفون», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:235-235.t: The clause «ولكن لا تواعدوهُنَّ» is conjoined to something implied, i.e. "so mention them, but do not make them a promise". «سرًا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a secret promising". The maṣdar «إلا أن تقولوا»: accusative as a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), because it does not fall under his words «سرا». The clause «فاحذروه» is conjoined to the clause «واعلموا», with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله غفور» stands in place of the two objects of «علم».

harrat-mujtaba:236-236.t: The clause «إن طلقتم النساء» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «ما» in his words «ما لم تمسُّوهن» is a temporal maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative as an adverb, i.e. "the period of not touching", attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of "being established" to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The clause «على الموسع قدره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «متِّعوهن», and the link is implied, i.e. "among you".

harrat-mujtaba:237-237.t: His words «من قبل أن تمسوهُنَّ»: the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "before the touching". The clause «وقد فرضتم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تمسُّوهن». His words «فنصف»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is implied, i.e. "is upon you", and «ما» is a relative, muḍāf ilayhi. «إلا أن يعفون»: the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the accusative; the maṣdar is accusative as a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), because their forgoing the half is not of the same kind as their taking it; the implied form is "except in the case of their forgoing". The maṣdar «وأن تعفوا» is a mubtadaʾ, and «أقرب» is its khabar; the clause «عفوكم أقرب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «ولا تنسوا» is conjoined to the nominal «عفوكم أقرب».

harrat-mujtaba:239-239.t: «فرجالا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) whose governor is implied, i.e. "then guard it on foot". His words «كما علَّمكم»: the kāf, meaning "like" (مثل), is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is "a remembrance like what He taught you". The second «ما» is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «علَّمكم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:240-240.t: His words «وصية لأزواجهم»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is implied, i.e. "they bequeath a bequest"; this implied (verb) is the clause that is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». «متاعا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "provide for them a provision"; it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), and «غير» is a naʿt (adjective) of «متاعا». The clause «فإن خرجن» is conjoined to the nominal clause «الذين يُتَوَفَّون», with no grammatical position. The preposition «من معروف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied returning pronoun, i.e. "(what) they did, being of what is right". His words «عزيز حكيم»: two khabars of the mubtadaʾ, the name of Majesty.

harrat-mujtaba:241-241.t: «حقا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, and the preposition «على المتقين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حقا». The clause «وللمطلقات متاع» is conjoined to the clause «والذين يتوفون», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:242-242.t: (كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "Allah makes clear with a making-clear like that making-clear", and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:243-243.t: The clause «وهم ألوف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «خرجوا». «حذر»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative. His words «ثم أحياهم»: conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "so they died, then He revived them". The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يشكرون» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله لذو».

harrat-mujtaba:245-245.t: «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a demonstrative, its khabar (predicate), and «الذي» is a badal (substitute) from «ذا». «قرضا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being «إقراضا»; the second object is omitted, i.e. "wealth". His words «فيضاعفه»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and the verb is accusative by «أن» necessarily implied after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "is there a loan to Allah, and (thus) a multiplying from Him for you?". «أضعافا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «والله يقبض» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «يبسط».

harrat-mujtaba:246-246.t: The two prepositions «من بني» and «من بعد» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملأ»; the attachment of the two prepositions to a single governor does no harm because they differ in meaning: the first «مِنْ» is partitive, and the second is for the beginning of the extent. «إذ» is an adverb, badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from «الملأ». His words «نقاتل» is jussive because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. His words «عسيتم»: an abrogating verb, and the pronoun is its noun; the clause «إن كُتب عليكم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the maṣdar «ألا تقاتلوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى». His words «وما لنا ألا نقاتل»: the wāw conjoins to an implied clause which is the speech (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. "they said: we will fight, and why should we not fight"; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun «لنا» are attached to the implied khabar; and the interpreted maṣdar «ألا نقاتل» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «وقد أُخرجنا» is a ḥāl; the clause «فلما كُتب عليهم القتال» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the clause «تولَّوا» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. «قليلا» is excepted from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:247-247.t: «ملكا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «طالوت». «أنى»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, and «يكون» is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate), «الملك» is its noun, and the preposition «علينا» is attached to a ḥāl from «الملك». The clause «ونحن أحق» is a ḥāl, and the preposition «بالملك» is attached to «أحق», and so is «منه». His words «زاده بسطة في العلم»: the verb is transitive to two objects, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an implied naʿt (adjective) of «بسطة». The two objects of «يؤتي» — «ملكه من يشاء» — have had a fronting and postponing between them: the first is «مَنْ», and the second is «ملكه».

harrat-mujtaba:248-248.t: The maṣdar «أن يأتيكم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». The clause «فيه سكينة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «التابوت». The preposition «ممَّا ترك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بقية», and the clause «تحمله الملائكة» is a ḥāl from «التابوت». The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:249-249.t: The clause «فلما فصل» is resumptive. «لمَّا»: a particle of "necessity because of necessity" (wujūb li-wujūb). The clause «فمن شرب» is conjoined to the speech (maqūl al-qawl). His words «إلا من اغترف غرفة»: «من» is a relative noun, a joined excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil) from his words «فمن شرب منه فليس مني», and «غُرفَة» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is of the pattern fuʿla in the sense of a passive participle. «قليلا» is accusative as a joined exception from the wāw in «شربوا». The pronoun «هو» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in «جاوز». The maṣdar «أنهم ملاقو الله» stands in place of the two objects of «ظنَّ». «كم» is declarative (khabariyya), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «من فئة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «كم». The clause «غلبت» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «كم».

harrat-mujtaba:250-250.t: «لما» is a particle of "necessity because of necessity" (wujūb li-wujūb); the clause «قالوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:251-251.t: The preposition «بإذن الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «هزموهم». His words «ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض»: the wāw is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of "non-occurrence because of necessity" (imtināʿ li-wujūb) [Translator's note: so in the source; the usual term is imtināʿ li-wujūd]; «دفع» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing"; «الناس» is the object of the maṣdar «دفع», «بعضهم» is a badal (substitute) from «الناس», and the preposition «ببعض» is attached to the maṣdar (دَفْع). The clause «ولكن الله ذو» is conjoined to the clause «لفسدت الأرض», with no grammatical position. The preposition «على العالمين» is attached to the maṣdar (فضل).

harrat-mujtaba:252-252.t: The clause «نتلوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آيات الله», its governor being the meaning of pointing in «تلك». The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from the object of «نتلوها». The lām in «لمن المرسلين» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), because it occurs in the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:253-253.t: «الرسل» is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; the clause «فضَّلنا» is the khabar (predicate) of «تلك», and the clause «منهم من كلَّم الله» is resumptive. «درجات» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the verb's being made to include the meaning of «بلّغ» (to bring to). «البينات» is a second object. The clause «ولو شاء الله» is resumptive; the preposition «من بعد ما جاءتهم البينات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اقتتل»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «ولكن اختلفوا» is conjoined to the conditional clause before it, and the clause «فمنهم من آمن» is conjoined to the clause «اختلفوا».

harrat-mujtaba:254-254.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أي», and the clause «أنفقوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The two prepositions «ممَّا رزقناكم من قبل» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنفقوا»; the attachment of the two prepositions to a single governor is permitted because their meanings differ: the first «من» is partitive, and the second is for the beginning of the extent. The maṣdar «أن يأتي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «لا بيع فيه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم». His words «ولا خلة»: «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation, and «خلة» is a conjoined noun. The clause «والكافرون هم الظالمون» is resumptive, and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:255-255.t: «لا»: the lā of generic negation, working like «إن»; «إله» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the khabar (predicate) is implied, its implied form being "deserving of worship". «إلا» is for restriction, «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent pronoun in the khabar, and «الحيّ القيوم» are two khabars of the name of Majesty; likewise the clause «لا تأخذه سنة» and the clause «له ما في السماوات». His words «من ذا الذي»: «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a demonstrative, its khabar; and «الذي» is a badal. The preposition «بإذنه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يشفع». The clause «وسع كرسيه» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «وهو العلي» is conjoined to the clause «لا يؤوده», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:256-256.t: The clause «قد تبيَّن الرشد» is resumptive; the preposition «من الغيّ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تبين», made to include the meaning of «تميز» (to be distinguished). «لا انفصام لها»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, working like «إنَّ», and «انفصام» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. His words «فمن»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «والله سميع عليم» is resumptive, and the two (سميع and عليم) are two khabars (predicates), nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:257-257.t: The clause «يخرجهم» is a second khabar (predicate) of the name of Majesty, and the clause «أولياؤهم الطاغوت» is the khabar of «الذين». The clause «يخرجونهم» is a second khabar of «الذين كفروا», and the clause «أولئك أصحاب» is resumptive. The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar of «أولئك», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:258-258.t: His words «أن آتاه الله الملك»: «أن» is a maṣdar particle; «آتاه» is a past verb transitive to two objects: the hāʾ and «الملك». The interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām. «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حاجَّ». «فإنَّ الله يأتي»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you claim that, then Allah…", and the implied clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. «فأتِ»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are able, then bring it". The implied clause is in the position of the accusative as the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:259-259.t: «أو كالذي»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), conjoined to the preceding relative, i.e. "have you not seen the one who disputed, or the like of the one who passed by". The clause «وهي خاوية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative, and the preposition «على عروشها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خاوية». «أنَّى»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, and «هذه» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. «مائة عام»: an adverb of time attached to «أماته». «كم»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to «لبثت», and its tamyīz (specification) is omitted, i.e. "how many days". His words «فانظر»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are in doubt, then look", and the clause «لم يتسنَّه» is a ḥāl. His words «ولنجعلك آية»: the wāw is parenthetical, and the lām is causal (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "We did that", and the clause is parenthetical between the two verbs. «كيف»: an interrogative noun, a ḥāl, and the clause «كيف ننشزها» is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from «العظام», in the position of the genitive. The clause «فلمَّا تبيَّن» is resumptive, and the fāʿil (agent) of «تبيَّن له» is implied, its implied form being "the manner of giving life". The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «علم», and the preposition «على كل» is attached to «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:260-260.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is resumptive, and «إذ» is an adverbial noun, object of an implied "remember". «أرني كيف تحي»: the seeing here is visual, transitive to one (object); when the hamza of transfer entered, it gave the verb a second object; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «كيف تحي الموتى» is the second object of «أرني». «أولم تؤمن»: the wāw conjoins to an implied clause, i.e. "do you ask, and have you not believed?". His words «ولكن ليطمئن»: the wāw conjoins to something implied, i.e. "yes, I have believed, but I asked You so that my heart may be at rest". The maṣdar «أن يطمئن» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (verb), i.e. "I asked You for the rest of my heart". The clause «سألتك ليطمئن» is conjoined to the implied clause «آمنت» before it. «قال فخذ»: the fāʾ introduces the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you want that, then take". The preposition «إليك» is attached to something implied, its implied form being "I mean"; it is not attached to «صُرهنَّ», because the verb of an attached pronoun does not pass over to its own attached pronoun except in the chapters of ẓanna, faqada and ʿadima. His words «سعيا»: a ḥāl, interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "running"; the clause «يأتينك» is the apodosis of an implied condition, in the position of the jussive, i.e. "if you call them, they will come to you".
